items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-generated scams that are more convincing and harder to spot than ever. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has warned that attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in TeamCity servers here in Australia — if your organisation uses this software for software development, it needs to be patched immediately.

Globally, security researchers are seeing a rise in banking trojans and sophisticated malware loaders that can lead to ransomware attacks, trends that are making their way to Australian networks.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected invoice or urgent payment request by email, verify it by calling the sender directly using a phone number you already have on file — not one provided in the email.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
